objective: Restore executable scientific-validation workflow syntax before source-backed benchmark execution.

baseline.description: The heavy scientific-validation job contained malformed step indentation and non-normalized multiline shell commands.

lifecycle_contract_coverage.before: workflow parser/runtime could not reliably execute the heavy job

evidence: Scientific Validation workflow run 149 completed successfully.
Registry and cumulative lifecycle contract validation completed successfully.

root_causes: Malformed indentation placed heavy-job run keys at the wrong YAML level.
Several shell commands were flattened into hard-to-audit single lines.

findings: Workflow syntax must be validated by the live Scientific Validation workflow, not only by static source inspection.
Multiline scientific acquisition commands should remain structurally readable and executable.

open_blockers: PR CI must complete successfully before this lifecycle stage is finalized.
